reason: GroupPermissionsV2.java:144-147 passes the result of getResourceTypeResource straight to policyStore.findByResource with no null check, and that method returns null (AdminPermissionsSchema.java:134-135) whenever the realm's adminPermissionsEnabled is false while the admin-permissions client and resource server still exist (e.g. enabled then disabled, or imported via RealmManager.java:567-570); findByResource then dereferences resource.getId() (StoreFactoryCacheSession.java:938, JPAPolicyStore.java:215). The NPE is limited to that state and to admins lacking the short-circuiting roles, not every group check.
